# Open Business Application Framework (OBAF)

> The ultra-fast, single-binary, headless business operations, billing, and workflow engine built in Rust. Single binary. Multi-tenant. Multi-database. 100% API-driven.

OBAF delivers a high-performance alternative to legacy monolithic ERPs (Odoo, ERPNext, MedusaJS) with sub-3ms request latencies, ~20MB memory footprint, 128-bit decimal arithmetic for financial precision, and 22 out-of-the-box industry domain presets.

## Core Capabilities & Primitives
- [Architecture](docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md): The 6 Universal Primitives (Resource/Unit, Catalog Item, Customer/Party, Order/Ticket, Status Workflow, Ledger & Bill).
- [API Standards](docs/API_STANDARDS.md): RESTful JSON conventions, standard error codes, pagination, and OpenAPI 3.1 specification.
- [Database Architecture](docs/DATABASE_ARCHITECTURE.md): SeaORM abstraction supporting zero-config SQLite and clustered PostgreSQL with TenantPoolRouter.
- [Multi-Tenancy](docs/MULTI_TENANCY_AND_AUTHORIZATION.md): Multi-tenant row-level isolation and dedicated enterprise database pool routing.
- [System Design Primer](docs/SYSTEM_DESIGN.md): Token bucket rate limiters, cache-aside TTL caches, and circuit breaker resilience patterns.

## Domain Presets & Quickstarts
- [Preset Specifications](docs/PRESET_SPECIFICATION.md): Specifications for 22 domain presets across Hospitality, Healthcare, Retail, Services, Logistics, and Manufacturing.
- [Developer Setup](docs/DEVELOPER_SETUP.md): Local development workflow with Cargo, Make, SQLite, and Docker.
- [Deployment Runbook](docs/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md): Production clustering, Kubernetes manifests, horizontal pod autoscaling, and backup/restore.

## Client SDKs
- [TypeScript SDK](sdk/typescript/README.md): Official zero-dependency `@obaf/sdk` client for Node.js, Bun, Deno, and Next.js.
- [Python SDK](sdk/python/README.md): Official zero-dependency `obaf-sdk` client for Python 3.8+ automations, data pipelines, and AI agents.

## Quick CLI Reference
- `obaf init <project> --preset <preset>`: Scaffold a turnkey project with Docker Compose, TypeScript, and Python clients.
- `obaf doctor`: Verify database connectivity, migrations, and domain presets.
- `obaf presets`: List all 22 domain preset templates.
- `obaf token --role admin`: Generate signed JWT admin token for API debugging.
- `obaf backup`: Atomic SQLite database snapshot.
- `obaf restore --source <file>`: Restore database from backup.

## Core API & UI Endpoints
- `GET /admin` / `GET /superadmin`: Embedded zero-dependency Super Admin Web Console.
- `GET /health`, `/live`, `/ready`, `/metrics`: System health, liveness/readiness probes, and Prometheus metrics.
- `GET /swagger-ui`: Interactive Swagger UI documentation.
- `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1 JSON specification.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/schema`: Dynamic JSON schema discovery for headless UI auto-generation.
- `POST /api/v1/admin/setup/preset`: 1-call tenant onboarding with domain preset (enforces mandatory admin_password >= 8 chars).
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: Tenant user authentication returning Bearer JWT token (with anti-brute force lockout and timing-attack equalization).
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`: Revoke active tenant session token with instant cryptographic blacklist.
- `POST /api/v1/superadmin/login`: Super Admin authentication via email/password or Google SSO.
- `POST /api/v1/superadmin/logout`: Revoke Super Admin session token.
- `POST /api/v1/superadmin/mfa-verify`: TOTP 2-Factor Authentication verification.
- `GET /api/v1/superadmin/ssl`: Let's Encrypt automated SSL certificate status, DNS verification, and auto-renewal.
- `POST /api/v1/superadmin/organizations`: Provision organizations and configure dynamic API module gating (enforces mandatory admin_password >= 8 chars).
- `GET /api/v1/superadmin/database/backup`: 1-click database JSON snapshot backup.
- `POST /api/v1/catalog`: Create products with dynamic custom schema validation.
- `POST /api/v1/orders`: Create orders with state machine transitions and Idempotency-Key support.
- `POST /api/v1/billing/split`: Split bill calculation with penny-perfect reconciliation.
- `POST /api/v1/procurement/orders`: Purchase order lifecycle and automatic stock inward movements.
- `POST /api/v1/billing/convert-currency`: High-precision 128-bit decimal currency conversion.
- `POST /api/v1/sync`: Monotonic offline-first POS batch synchronization.
